prose:
Foolscap’s short landing page describes a writing tool that tracks connections and unresolved threads in a book without generating prose for the writer. The author’s launch post presents it as a way to support rather than replace creative work.

The available product text is brief and the application was not tested. Its ability to understand a full manuscript, preserve privacy or improve writing is not established by the pitch.
highlights: Page says it does not write prose
Quality and privacy claims were not verified
